meta.about: Generated by scripts/design-tokens.mjs: color values and the radius scale are read from the paths below (theme.css is the one theme both portals import); usage notes, type, spacing, size, shadow and opacity are hand-written here. Run `npm run design-tokens` after changing a source; `npm run lint` fails when this file is stale.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App page ground (body bg-background), sheet and dialog panels, the active tab pill. Carries foreground and muted-foreground text in both themes.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on background, card and popover (about 18:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card surface (rounded-xl border shadow-sm). In dark it lifts one step above background.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Select, dropdown-menu and popover panels (rounded-md border shadow-md).

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Near-black (light) / near-white (dark) fill for the default Button, default Badge, checked Checkbox, Tooltip and Progress indicator. The one strong action per view. Also the link color.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label text and icons on a primary fill; flips with the theme, never literal white.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill; quiet actions beside a primary.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Recessed grounds: the app shell behind pages (bg-muted), TabsList tracks, sheet header (muted/50), table row hover (muted/50) and footer, avatar fallback.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, placeholders, captions, table metadata, inactive tabs, the (optional) label suffix. On background and muted it holds about 4.6:1 (light) and 7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlight fill for ghost/outline buttons and every menu, select and combobox item. Same value as secondary and muted by design.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on an accent (hovered) item.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive Button and Badge fill (label text-white; at 60% in dark), destructive menu items as text, aria-invalid borders and rings. Pair with a word (Delete, Archive), never color alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state as text or a tint: paid, connected, hours remaining, a done check (text-success, bg-success/10). The only green for status; never a raw emerald or green shade. Emerald-700 light, emerald-400 dark, so text holds 4.5:1 on background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not broken: pending, expiring, low hours, drift (text-warning, bg-warning/10). The only amber for status. Amber-700 light, amber-400 dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: the global default border color (* { border-border }), card and panel edges, table row rules, separators.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, Select trigger, Checkbox and outline-button borders; unchecked Switch track. In dark also the control fill at 30% (dark:bg-input/30).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus: focus-visible:border-ring plus a 3px ring-ring/50 halo on every control; also the global outline-ring/50.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. Chart hues change between themes (orange to blue), so never refer to a series by color name.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: App sidebar ground.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar nav text.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Sidebar primary fill; the one place dark mode turns blue (same as chart-1 dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-primary.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active and hovered sidebar item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on sidebar-accent.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and rules.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: brand-bg
tokens.usage: Marketing ground: auth screens (AuthShell), the public share-page masthead, email masthead. Always dark, in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-bg-card
tokens.usage: Card surface on brand-bg.

tokens.name: brand-bg-panel
tokens.usage: Translucent auth form panel over the dot grid, bordered brand-border.

tokens.name: brand-border
tokens.usage: Panel borders on brand-bg; also the 1px dots of the 24px BRAND_DOT_GRID.

tokens.name: brand-border-light
tokens.usage: Stronger rule on brand-bg.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Wordmark and headings on brand-bg (same as email-masthead-text).

tokens.name: brand-text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions on brand-bg and brand-bg-panel.

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: The brand accent. Only on dark grounds (brand-bg, dark theme): the blueprint mark's dot and frame (frame at 50%), corner brackets, the mono portal label. It all but vanishes on white (about 1.3:1): never use it on a light ground; use brand-lime-600 for the mark or email-accent-ink for text.

tokens.name: brand-lime-600
tokens.usage: Tailwind lime-600: the blueprint mark's dot (and frame at 60%) in the light theme, where brand-lime disappears. Mark only, about 3:1 on white; not for text.

tokens.name: email-ink
tokens.usage: Email body text on email-paper (EMAIL_COLORS.ink).

tokens.name: email-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary email copy on paper.

tokens.name: email-faint
tokens.usage: Footer and fine print in email, still 4.5:1+ on paper.

tokens.name: email-rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines in email.

tokens.name: email-paper
tokens.usage: Email body. Stays light on purpose: mail clients rewrite dark backgrounds and paper prints clean.

tokens.name: email-backdrop
tokens.usage: Canvas behind the email card.

tokens.name: email-masthead-text
tokens.usage: Wordmark and label on the dark email masthead (brand-bg).

tokens.name: email-accent
tokens.usage: Lime on the dark masthead only (same value as brand-lime).

tokens.name: email-accent-frame
tokens.usage: The mark's frame in email.

tokens.name: email-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Lime-700: the accent wherever it must read on paper (links, emphasis), about 5:1 on white.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist, loaded by next/font/google as --font-geist-sans and mapped to Tailwind font-sans. The app is dense: text-sm is the working size.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight. Rare: standalone pages only; dashboard pages title themselves through the breadcrumb.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: font-semibold at the inherited base size: SheetTitle, CardTitle (leading-none there).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: text-base: input and textarea text below md (keeps iOS from zooming); rich-text content.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: text-sm: the default for tables, inputs (md+), select and menu items, breadcrumbs, descriptions.

styles.name: ui-medium
styles.usage: text-sm font-medium: button labels, tab triggers, table headers, form labels (leading-none on Label).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: text-xs: metadata, select group labels, tooltips, compact table heads.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase: sidebar group labels, activity section heads. Field labels in detail panes use text-xs font-medium tracking-wide uppercase.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: text-[10px] font-semibold tabular-nums: sidebar count pills, compact source badges.

groups.name: Brand display
groups.note: Space Grotesk (--font-space-grotesk) is the marketing site's logo face. Only for the wordmark and brand-ground headlines, always bold and tight.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: BrandLogo lg (the marketing header's exact size): leading-none font-bold tracking-tight. md is 18px, sm 15px.

styles.name: auth-title
styles.usage: AuthShell h1 on brand-bg, in brand-text.

styles.name: share-headline
styles.usage: Public share pages (HEADLINE_FONT) and email headings.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Geist Mono (--font-geist-mono, Tailwind font-mono): identifiers, keys and micro-labels.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.1em]: the portal label under the auth lockup (brand-lime on brand-bg) and email masthead tags.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: font-mono text-[11px]: slugs and mono facts in the activity feed.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: font-mono text-[10px] in a bordered bg-muted kbd: shortcut hints.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale (0.25rem steps), used as written in the components.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: p-0.5: compact TabsList track padding; py-0.5 badge.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: p-1: menu and select list padding, TabsNav list; gap-1 inside badges.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: py-1.5: menu/select items and compact table cells; gap-1.5 in tab triggers.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: gap-2: built into every Button size and between icon and label; p-2 table cells; px-2 table heads.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: px-3 in inputs, select triggers, sm buttons; gap-3 in sheet footers and page header.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: p-4 sheet header and footer; px-4 default buttons; gap-4 inside sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: p-6 dialogs; card padding (py-6 px-6) and gap-6 between card sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: p-8 auth panel; space-y-8 between lockup and panel.

radius.note: One base, --radius: 0.625rem (10px); the rest derive from it in @theme.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: --radius (0.625rem), the base the others derive from; equals radius-lg.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: calc(var(--radius) - 4px): select and menu items (rounded-sm).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: calc(var(--radius) - 2px): buttons, inputs, select triggers, tab triggers, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: var(--radius): dialogs, TabsList track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: calc(var(--radius) + 4px): cards.

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: rounded-[4px]: Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, Switch track and thumb, Avatar, Progress, sidebar count pills.

size.note: Control heights (Tailwind h-*). Keep controls on one row the same height.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: h-7: Button xs, icon-sm row actions.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: h-8: Button sm, Select trigger sm, compact table head.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: h-9: default Button, Input, Select trigger, TabsList, icon button.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: h-10: Button lg, icon-lg, default table head row, TabsNav list.

shadow.note: Tailwind v4 defaults; the dark theme reuses them (they read mostly through borders). Focus ring colors are the ring token at 50%, converted to hex.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Controls at rest: Input, Select trigger, outline Button, Checkbox, Switch.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, the active tab pill, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Select, dropdown and popover panels.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, submenus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: focus-visible:ring-[3px] ring-ring/50 with border-ring: every input, trigger and button. Invalid fields swap to destructive/20 (dark /40).

tokens.name: overlay-sheet
tokens.usage: bg-black/50 backdrop behind sheets.

tokens.name: overlay-dialog
tokens.usage: bg-black/70 backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: disabled:opacity-50 on every control.
